subject.title: backup create stalls on large installations (4GB+ .openclaw dir)

question: What native backup scope should OpenClaw support for large state directories before this issue can close?
rationale: The remaining fix likely adds CLI flags/default backup exclusions and protected restore semantics, which is a product and security tradeoff rather than a narrow mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Rework native exclusions
options.body: Review or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 with restore-safe defaults, protected-path handling, docs, and live large-state proof.

options.title: Only document plugin workaround
options.body: Leave core backup behavior mostly as-is and document ClawHub/plugin backup options, accepting that this issue remains a native CLI limitation.

options.title: Split scope
options.body: Close only the proven tar/live-log race pieces and keep a narrower issue for configurable backup scope and progress/size UX.

recommendation.title: Rework native exclusions
recommendation.body: Review or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 with restore-safe defaults, protected-path handling, docs, and live large-state proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently merged and refined the backup live-race mitigation, making them the best available routing candidate for the remaining backup-scope decision.
